guard: manager inspect keeps live success local and closed, but distinguishes a nonterminal durable static slot from an unknown name with an honest ordered slot-plus-head observation
why: The suite drives the real manager service over ep.one. It plants a durable terminalizing slot and retiring lifecycle head after boot, so startup reconciliation cannot consume the fixture before inspect reads it.

The first mutation restores the shipped defect at the real entry point: inspect never consults durable state after a live-map miss. The second removes the cleanup-complete field while preserving the rest of the projection. The third removes the read-order marker while keeping both values, so a two-record pair can be mistaken for a snapshot.

BUILD FIRST and rebuild after restore. The manager smoke imports core and workspace through their dist outputs, and the command also refreshes manager dist. The source files are restored before afterRestore runs, so no ignored output remains compiled from a mutant.
